easy_fields.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
creator: Niklas Muennighoff
Nouamane Tazi
Loïc Magne
Nils Reimers
easy_fields.citeAs: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, and Nils Reimers. 2023. MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. arXiv preprint arXiv:2210.07316.
easy_fields.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) is a comprehensive benchmark for text embeddings, spanning 8 embedding tasks across 58 datasets and 112 languages. It aims to provide clarity on model performance across various embedding tasks and serves as a foundation for finding universal text embeddings.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper details how some datasets (e.g., ArxivClustering, RedditClusteringP2P) were custom-made for MTEB using public APIs or available data, and mentions reusing datasets from other benchmarks.

G4_annotation.reasoning: While the paper describes evaluation metrics and task definitions, it does not provide details on annotation protocols, platforms, or annotator demographics for the aggregated datasets.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses limitations of MTEB, such as task imbalance and missing data types, and touches on potential data contamination from model training data.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper describes preprocessing steps for evaluation (e.g., embedding sentences, training classifiers) and outlines a plan for maintenance and extensibility through community contributions and versioning.
